item.stem:
The diagram shows Nidhi's bar magnet held above a tray of paper clips. One half of the magnet is painted orange and labelled N; the other half is painted blue and labelled S.

Where does the magnet attract the paper clips most strongly?

options.A: Equally at every part of the bar magnet.
options.B: Near the two poles at the ends.
options.C: Most strongly in the middle and least at the ends.
